title: "devoirs3 Quarto smoke test"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(devoirs3)
devoirs_start("quarto-smoke", feedback = FALSE)
```

Please explain your answer.

`r devoirs_text(label = "response", question = "Explain your answer", placeholder = "Your response", width = 32, height = 4)`

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: smokeChoices
- "TRUE":
  correct: true
  feedback: "Fantastic!"
- "False"
- "Math: $\\pi$"
```

`r devoirs_selection(label = "yaml-choice", question = "Choose one", answers = smokeChoices)()`

```{r}
choice <- devoirs_selection(
  label = "choice",
  question = "Choose one",
  answers = list(list(text = "**A** and $x^2$", correct = TRUE, feedback = "**Correct:** $x^2$"))
)
```

`r choice(feedback = TRUE)`

A sentence `r devoirs_TF(correct = TRUE, label = "inline-tf", format = "Wilbur or Arthur")` continues here.

```{r}
stopifnot(devoirs3:::rolling_hash("abc") == 2946)
stopifnot(identical(smokeChoices, list(
  list(text = "TRUE", correct = TRUE, feedback = "Fantastic!"),
  list(text = "False", correct = FALSE, feedback = "Sorry."),
  list(text = "Math: $\\pi$", correct = FALSE, feedback = "Sorry.")
)))
cat("DEVOIRS3_SMOKE_OK\nDEVOIRS3_CHOICES_OK")
```
